messages:
Marta: sketching a hybrid-signal auto-fallback for the rollout console: combine entropy drop, quota headroom, and cost-pressure into a single decision engine. want to capture UX + audit requirements here.
Devon: love it. hybrid signals make sense. we need a deterministic replay path and a small human-facing reason for each decision. otherwise support tickets explode.
Ibrahim: for low-cost signals we can use token-diversity and a cheap perplexity proxy. cost-pressure is derived from recent token-per-request delta vs forecast. quota headroom is percentage remaining. each signal normalized 0..1 then weighted.
Marta: UX idea: rollout card shows a mini-disposition wheel with three spokes (entropy / quota / cost). hover shows the numeric contributions and the final routed_pct. clicking opens an expandable compact audit row list.
Devon: audit row must be CSV-friendly single line: ts,rollout_id,decision_type,routed_pct,mode,reason_code,signal_vec(repr),replay_seed,orig_route,final_route,tokens,operator_id_opt. consistent order so downstream users can parse.
Ibrahim: sampling plan: compact rows 0.02% default, full traces 0.0005%. anomaly triggers boost full-trace sampling by x100 for 5 minutes. NL blurb generation only for sampled full traces.
Marta: operator controls: Freeze (sets routed_pct=0), Pin (manual pct override per-tenant), and a Quick-Why that surfaces the top-2 signals and a confidence score. Freeze must write operator_id to audit and suppress alerts for configured hush-window.
Devon: replayability: include replay_seed + signal_snapshot + smoothing_state so SREs can replay a short window locally. expose an admin endpoint: /admin/rollouts/{id}/replay?seed=...&ts=... that returns the deterministic decision sequence.
Ibrahim: billing note: every routed request needs attribution tuple (orig,final,tokens) emitted to billing pipeline; include a routed_reason_code so invoices are explainable. also include token_cost_est in daily preview.
Marta: cost preview UX: when enabling a policy show a modal with median and p95 projected monthly token delta, absolute and percent, and a quick toggle to simulate pinning x% traffic to fallback. require ops ack for enterprise tenants.
Devon: telemetry & retention: default audit_retention_days=90. compact export endpoint should stream CSV rows for a timeframe. also add a lightweight histogram endpoint for routed_pct over time for console graphing.
Ibrahim: small config prototype (for RFC) we can paste into API section: 
```yaml
rollout_id: r_hybrid_01
mode: hybrid_signal
signals: 
  - name: token_diversity
    weight: 0.4
  - name: quota_headroom
    weight: 0.35
  - name: cost_pressure
    weight: 0.25
smoothing: { half_life: 10s, hysteresis: 20s }
guards:
  hard_escalate_window: 45s
  hard_escalate_threshold: 0.35
sampling:
  compact_audit_rate: 0.0002
  full_trace_rate: 0.000005
  anomaly_boost_multiplier: 100
telemetry:
  audit_retention_days: 90
  nl_blurb_enabled: false
operator_controls: { freeze: true, pin_api: /v1/rollouts/{id}/pin }
```
Marta: audit-bot - can you create tickets for metric catalog entries and billing schema changes?
audit-bot: created PLAT-3456 (metric catalog) and BILL-8910 (billing export attribution).
deploy-bot: when hybrid_signal mode is enabled for any tenant deploy-bot will post a compact summary to #eng-platform containing the top reason codes and an estimated hourly cost delta. :robot_face:
Devon: one more: add a small "explainability export" option in admin that bundles sampled NL blurbs + compact CSV for legal review. must be gated behind enterprise permission.
Ibrahim: agree. also recommend storing the replayable compact rows in immutable storage for the retention period so legal/SRE can fetch them later.
Marta: next steps - i'll draft a short RFC with the API config, CSV schema, and a couple of UI mocks. tagging Devon & Ibrahim for review. thanks. :thumbsup:
